# How much Capital Gains Tax will I owe?

> Free UK Capital Gains Tax calculator for 2025/26 and 2026/27: enter the sale, costs, losses and your income to see the tax at 18% and 24%, the annual exempt amount and how to report it. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
